item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi phya tshe g.yang gi bsgrub pa'i mngon rtogs
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni grwa pa rnams kyis bskul nas gnas chen bon ri'i yang dgon du/ bde chen lha ri zhes bya ba na/ dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams su/ dus mtha'i sgrub pa po/ bya btang rin chen gros kyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
